title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZI (General and other reserves)

content.overview: Every Producer Company must maintain a general reserve in each financial year, in addition to any reserve specified in its articles. If it lacks sufficient funds in a financial year to transfer the amount needed to maintain reserves specified in its articles, the contribution to the reserve is shared among Members in proportion to their patronage in the company's business during that year.
content.glance: Section 378ZI requires an annual general reserve and, where funds are insufficient to maintain article-specified reserves, apportions the required contribution among Members by that year's patronage.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZI (General and other reserves). Every Producer Company must maintain a general reserve in every financial year, in addition to any reserve specified in its articles. If the company lacks sufficient funds in a financial year for transfer to maintain reserves specified in its articles, the contribution to the reserve is shared among Members in proportion to their patronage in the company's business in that year. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Annual general reserve
sections.body: Every Producer Company shall maintain a general reserve in every financial year, in addition to any reserve maintained as may be specified in its articles.

sections.heading: Insufficient funds for article-specified reserves
sections.body: If the Producer Company does not have sufficient funds in a financial year for transfer to maintain the reserves specified in its articles, the contribution to the reserve is shared among Members in proportion to their patronage in the business of the company in that year.

provisions.title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZI: General and other reserves

examples.title: Applying the patronage allocation
examples.body: Where the company lacks sufficient funds to transfer to article-specified reserves, identify each Member's patronage in the company's business during that financial year and apply the statutory proportional allocation rule.

hypotheticals.question: A Producer Company lacks sufficient funds to transfer to the reserves specified in its articles in a financial year. How does section 378ZI allocate the contribution?
hypotheticals.analysis: The section provides that the contribution to the reserve is shared among Members in proportion to their patronage in the company's business in that year. Use the relevant financial year and patronage data; do not substitute shareholding or an invented equal allocation.

distinctions.title: Patronage-based reserve contribution and shareholding-based allocation
distinctions.left: Section 378ZI allocates a reserve contribution among Members in proportion to patronage in the company's business during the relevant year when the specified funds are insufficient.
distinctions.right: Shareholding is not the allocation measure stated in section 378ZI.

rows.right: Number or value of shares held

rows.left: Insufficient funds to maintain reserves specified in the articles
rows.right: Not the trigger or measure stated in section 378ZI

misconceptions.trap: Treating the annual general-reserve duty as optional because the articles may specify other reserves.
misconceptions.correction: Section 378ZI requires a general reserve every financial year in addition to any reserve specified in the articles.

misconceptions.trap: Allocating a required reserve contribution equally or by shareholding when the statutory trigger applies.
misconceptions.correction: Where funds are insufficient for article-specified reserves, the contribution is shared in proportion to Members' patronage in the business during that year.

misconceptions.trap: Using patronage from a different financial year.
misconceptions.correction: The section refers to patronage in the business of the company in that year.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does section 378zi do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: A Producer Company maintains a general reserve and such other reserves as the articles or the section require, and applies them only for the purposes stated.
